name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Slate goes with at least one of Edith, Chai, or $12.

If $13 goes with Americano, then Jade goes with $12.
The Chai order's price is lower than both Edith and the order in the Jade mug.
Either Ava goes with $12 or $14 goes with Macchiato.
Between Ava and Greta, one goes with $12 and the other with $14.
